acv.quote: A hundred and eighty K a year, on a three-year term.

header.reason: A Fetchwell engineer built a working sitter payment flow over a weekend after our docs and sandbox drew a reaction. That ended the bake-off for Daniel. Priya says the engineer sold it, not her.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with freeing engineers from payment upkeep when launching new countries.
findings.why: Fetchwell was launching Canada and the UK while two engineers just kept sitter payments running.
findings.quote: Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Aim the main message at the engineering head, not finance.
findings.why: Daniel, VP of Engineering, signed. The CFO joined for ten minutes and asked one question.
findings.quote: this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Say plainly what stays when switching: PayPal, Venmo and saved cards.
findings.why: After a Braintree call, Fetchwell's questions turned to losses. Priya only guesses Braintree caused this.
findings.quote: It went from 'how fast can we build this' to 'what do we lose.'

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Cut the average acceptance uplift claim for small-ticket buyers.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Daniel waved off the acceptance-rate slide because Fetchwell's bookings are small.
findings.quote: our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a story of a similar-size company moving saved cards without losses.
findings.why: Priya first said nothing was missing, but Daniel's reference request went unanswered and came back at kickoff.
findings.quote: who's done this at our size without losing cards?

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'sitter pay' and 'paid by Friday' instead of 'payouts'.

line.text: Instant payouts 24x7, including weekends and holidays

findings.why: Fetchwell's promise to sitters is 'paid by Friday'. The CFO's only question was about when sitters get paid.
